owner_directive: generate many market situations so that no situation is new to the model; use them in buy/sell training, then verify on unseen paths/conditions and on the real record
single_axis: training data composition: arm A = real only (frozen timing-lgbm-v1 pipeline) vs arm B = real + generated paths; target, six features, LightGBM parameters, 12 execution-year folds, sign policy with cost band off (same as M2: plain sign of p), integer ledger all frozen

step_1_generator_pilot_no_fits.generator: G1 regime-switching daily open/close generator in integer won with a 5-won tick
step_1_generator_pilot_no_fits.state: regime s_t in {ascent, descent, sideways, crash, rebound, highvol}; episode durations geometric with family-specific mean L_s; transitions by a fixed row-stochastic matrix T (declared below); the regime sequence, durations and parameters are hidden simulator state stored separately and never exposed to features
step_1_generator_pilot_no_fits.returns: daily log return r_t = m_s + sqrt(h_t) * sigma_s * e_t, e_t ~ standardized Student-t(df) iid; volatility clustering multiplier h_t = (1 - a - b) + a * e_{t-1}^2 + b * h_{t-1} with h_0 = 1 (unit mean); sideways adds mean reversion -k * (log C_{t-1} - log C_anchor) with the anchor fixed at the episode start
step_1_generator_pilot_no_fits.jumps: with probability lambda per day add J ~ Uniform(-0.08, +0.05) to r_t and force the next regime draw (gap then continuation or reversal)
step_1_generator_pilot_no_fits.overnight_intraday: r_t = r_on + r_in with r_on ~ N(0.4 m_s, f_on * v_t) and r_in = r_t - r_on where v_t is the day's conditional variance; O_t = round5(C_{t-1} * exp(r_on)), C_t = round5(C_{t-1} * exp(r_t)); round5 = nearest 5-won tick with a floor of 5 won; coherent positive integer O and C; the adjusted series is set equal to the close (no distributions in synthetic paths)
step_1_generator_pilot_no_fits.parameter_variation_grid: multipliers applied per path: duration x{0.5,1,2}, drift x{0.5,1,1.5}, sigma x{0.7,1,1.4}, df {3,4,6}, (a,b) in {(.05,.85),(.10,.85),(.05,.90)}, f_on {0.3,0.5}, lambda {0, 1/250, 1/60}; 2,916 combinations; a seeded draw selects 150 combinations: 120 for training/check and 30 held out for test (unseen parameter/transition combinations)
step_1_generator_pilot_no_fits.paths: length 5,938 sessions each, labelled with the real session calendar dates (time axis only, so the 12 execution-year folds apply identically); start price 20,000 won; training 240 paths (120 combos x 2 seeds), check 60 paths (same 120 combos, 60 new seeds), test 60 paths (30 held-out combos x 2 new seeds); split by whole path/seed/combination before any windowing; no window is shared across splits
step_1_generator_pilot_no_fits.stored: every path (O, C), its combination id, multipliers, seed, regime sequence and durations, jump dates, generator version and code hash; descriptive stylized-fact table per family (daily sd, excess kurtosis, |r| autocorrelation, max drawdown, 1-year return quantiles) and the same table for the real series, for comparison only, never for fitting the generator
step_1_generator_pilot_no_fits.no_calibration: all parameters are ex-ante assumptions; the generator is not fitted to the full real period or to any fold; if bill prefers fold-cutoff calibration later it is a separate scope
step_1_generator_pilot_no_fits.resources: CPU 1 thread, external timeout 300 s, numpy RNG with declared seeds, 0 fits, 0 ledgers; output work/scenario_paths_v1_20261106 (paths as JSON or npz with hashes)

step_2_training_comparison_after_step_1_.arm_A: frozen M2 (timing-lgbm-v1, d9556ca9) loaded as the real-only arm; optional parity refit of the 12 real-only models inside the new code to prove the shared code path reproduces M2 bit-exactly (bill decides whether this refit is allowed)
step_2_training_comparison_after_step_1_.arm_B: per execution-year fold y with real cutoff c_y: training rows = all matured real rows (as M2) plus matured synthetic rows from the 240 training paths at path positions j <= c_y - 21 (same maturity rule on the synthetic path), subsampled deterministically (seeded) to one synthetic row-pair per real row-pair so synthetic row count equals real row count in every fold; unit weights; effective training size doubles so min_data_in_leaf 200 and lambda_l2 1 act on 2x rows (documented, not tuned)
step_2_training_comparison_after_step_1_.features_and_labels: identical functions: five price features from the path's own close prefix plus held 0/1; targets z(i,0), z(i,1) from the path's own raw opens P = O[i+1], Q = O[i+21] with the integer fee rule; no family/seed/regime/jump information anywhere in features
step_2_training_comparison_after_step_1_.learner: LightGBM parameters of timing-lgbm-v1 unchanged (200 rounds, leaves 7, depth 3, lr .05, min_leaf 200, l2 1, deterministic, 1 thread); 12 fits for arm B (+12 optional parity fits)
step_2_training_comparison_after_step_1_.policy: sign of p with the actual held state (M2 rule); cost band not applied (single axis)
step_2_training_comparison_after_step_1_.evaluation_real: arm B rollout on the real calendar/ledger 2014-12-30 .. 2026-11-05; compare with arm A (M2 loaded) and R1 loaded: terminal PnL, drawdown, exposure, trades, costs, annual increments
step_2_training_comparison_after_step_1_.evaluation_synthetic: both arms rolled out on the 60 check and 60 test paths with the same ledger (deposits 10,000 per session, integer costs), applying fold-y models to the path positions of fold y; per path: policy minus always-long post-cost PnL and drawdown; reported as distributions by scenario family and by seen/unseen combination; no profit from any evaluation path may change generator, weights or thresholds
step_2_training_comparison_after_step_1_.fit_and_resource_caps: fits 12 (arm B) + 12 optional parity = at most 24; ledgers: 1 real (arm B) + 240 synthetic (120 paths x 2 arms) = 241; CPU 1 thread; external timeout 900 s; estimated wall under 3 minutes
step_2_training_comparison_after_step_1_.reporting: distribution tables (min/median/max/share positive of policy minus always-long) per family; real-calendar comparison arm B vs arm A vs R1; explicit statement that synthetic profit does not validate real edge and that coverage of all future situations is not claimed; scenario families where neither arm shows an edge are listed

leakage_controls: generator parameters are not fitted to real data
no family, seed, regime, duration or jump information in features
teacher labels use future prices only inside the training path and only for matured rows at the fold cutoff
rollout policy sees only the observed path prefix and its own account
evaluation paths (check/test) never enter training; test combinations never appear in training or check
real evaluation uses the same frozen fold cutoffs as M2
open_choices_for_bill: allow the optional 12 parity refits for arm A (recommended once, to prove the shared code path) vs load M2 only
whether sideways mean reversion is kept as a distinct family (drafted) or folded into highvol
whether to also roll out M2 (arm A) on synthetic paths before step 2 as a pure diagnostic (0 fits)
